definitions.gloss: aesthetic eye; eye for beauty; discerning taste
definitions.explanation: The ability to recognize and appreciate what is beautiful or of high quality. Used for people who have refined taste in art, design, fashion, or craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {審美眼|しんびがん}を{養|やしな}う。
examples.english: To cultivate an eye for beauty.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{優|すぐ}れた{審美眼|しんびがん}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
examples.english: He has an excellent eye for beauty.

examples.japanese: {本物|ほんもの}の{芸術|げいじゅつ}に{触|ふ}れることで{審美眼|しんびがん}が{磨|みが}かれる。
examples.english: By experiencing genuine art, one's aesthetic sensibility is refined.

notes: Composed of {審美|しんび} (aesthetics, appreciation of beauty) + {眼|がん} (eye, discernment). Common collocations: {審美眼|しんびがん}を{養|やしな}う (to cultivate an aesthetic eye), {審美眼|しんびがん}を{磨|みが}く (to refine one's eye for beauty), {審美眼|しんびがん}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし} (a person with an eye for beauty). A somewhat literary or formal word. Related: {目利|めき}き (connoisseur, expert judge) is more colloquial.
